reference_baseline: 2019 NYC listing snapshot; replace only after a newer independent labelled snapshot is validated

actions.warning: Investigate input quality, category drift, class mix, and prediction distribution. Do not auto-retrain.
actions.critical: Hold model promotion, investigate root cause, obtain reviewed labels, run temporal and grouped validation, and retain the last approved artifact for rollback.

retraining_gates: dataset provenance and target-label quality verified
feature availability at prediction time verified
class-wise precision and recall meet agreed product requirements
rollback: Keep immutable model artifacts and metadata. Promote by changing a model-registry pointer only after verification; revert the pointer if monitoring gates fail.
